text: This is a status update, as requested by Council, of the Council-approved transfer of 24 uninhabitable Toronto Community Housing Corporation houses to non-profit organizations serving the following populations: - Indigenous people - Refugees - Youth - Victims of human trafficking In addition to serving one or more of the identified populations, organizations must also have capital funds sufficient to rehabilitate the identified properties. To date, 28 organizations have been contacted and asked to indicate interest in being a transferee organization.
The Executive Committee received the report (June 28, 2018) from the Interim Deputy City Manager, Cluster A for information.
